beats.say: A Show HN project offers fast, deterministic natural-language search over OpenStreetMap data, turning plain queries into map results.
Type a plain query, like cafes by the Limmat 100 metres from the lake in Zurich, and it returns the matching places on the map.
The search is deterministic, so the same query returns the same results every time, no ranking roulette, just the places that match.
